title: phoebe dunniana
intro: Phoebe dunniana, commonly known as Chinese forest berry or yinchenhao, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lauraceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China, used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits. Phoebe dunniana is valued for its potential to lower blood pressure and alleviate symptoms of hyperlipidemia, and is also reported to have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
